summary: Transocean Ltd. filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, disclosing that it received a Second Request from the DOJ under the HSR Act regarding its pending acquisition of Valaris Limited. The deal, announced February 9, 2026, involves Transocean issuing 15.235 shares per Valaris share. Both parties are cooperating with the DOJ review; the HSR waiting period is now extended until 30 days after substantial compliance with the Second Request. This antitrust development is a procedural step in a stock-for-stock merger of offshore drilling contractors. The risk-arb angle is monitoring the DOJ clearance timeline and any potential consent decree or challenge.
